title: The Computer Revolution Hasn't Happened Yet OOPSLA 97 Keynote (VPRI 0719)
summary: Alan Kay's 1997 OOPSLA keynote argues that the computer revolution has not really happened yet, reflecting on how computing, objects and the web fall short of their potential.
why: HN regards it as a must-watch that gives a very different perspective on software and the web, and its title is widely riffed on.

quote.text: if you have never watched this talk completely at least once, give it a shot and you might be very surprised.
